body: Source: codex/w5-impact lane, GitHub #781 remainder. Proposal: per-call root/snapshot/revision with repository-identity validation and a typed refusal. Conflict: MCPV0-015 non-goal (no client-driven authority). Needs an owner decision before work.

completion.reason: DECLINED by the orchestrator under owner delegation (2026-10-11, "resolve V1-0906, V1-1157 and V1-1172 for me"): a per-call MCP worktree root conflicts with MCPV0-015 (server bound to its launch root). Delivered remedy is MMR-V0-009 (V1-1173) in beamfall/corvint#799 at 10efc02d16e6069d73426e6d6abd860e71ae83ab; recorded in decision 0519. GitHub #781 closed with this rationale. Evidence: sha256 of decision 0519 at the merge commit.
